metadata.description:
The Tribal Kitchen team is no stranger to surprises. When you travel deep into remote tribal regions — sometimes right inside dense jungles — communication gaps are almost guaranteed.

This time, we were in the heart of the Satpura जंगल. We were supposed to reach by 12:00 PM… but we got delayed. With no proper network, our host assumed we would arrive extremely hungry.

What happened next turned into absolute fun — and an unforgettable feast in the middle of the jungle!

Watch the full episode to experience this unexpected twist, warm hospitality, and authentic tribal flavours straight from Satpura.
